description: Tool-output masking (CX-4): rename a helper used in 18 files; reading them all is expensive and the model must remember what it saw.
objective: Rename the helper `fmt` to `formatValue` everywhere: its definition and export in src/util.js and every use in src/m1.js to src/m18.js and src/index.js. Keep behaviour and every comment unchanged, and keep npm test passing. The old name must not remain.
